description: Read a file from the sandbox (absolute `path`, max 5 MB). Returns `content` as UTF-8 text by default; set `as_text: false` to get `content_base64` for binary files. Requires: token + live sandbox_id. Max 5 MB.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id as returned by create_sandbox / list_sandboxes, e.g. "sb_3f2a…".

name: download_file
title: Download a file from a sandbox
